req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that every /tasks/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) GET /tasks/ positive path — list endpoint returns JSON content-type with 200; (2) POST /tasks/ positive path — create endpoint returns JSON content-type with 201; (3) GET /tasks/{id} positive path — single-task endpoint returns JSON content-type with 200; (4) PUT /tasks/{id} positive path — update endpoint returns JSON content-type with 200; (5) GET /tasks/{id} negative path — 404 error body is also JSON content-type; (6) POST /tasks/ negative path — 422 validation error body is also JSON content-type; (7) BVA boundary — DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 No Content with no body, so content-type assertion is not applicable, but we verify status is exactly 204 and body is empty; (8) BVA — GET /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=1 boundary returns JSON. Each test asserts the exact content-type string to catch mutations that change or omit the header value.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
trace: R-TASK-025: all /tasks endpoints returning a body must return application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_task_create_returns_json_content_type
actions: Send POST request to /tasks/ with valid JSON payload
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body contains the created task fields
trace: R-TASK-025: POST /tasks/ returns a body and must use application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_task_create_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Test content type task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Test content type task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert "created_at" in body

test_post_task_create_returns_json_content_type()
